8: # SEO On-Page: Open Graph
9: 
10: Guides implementation of Open Graph meta tags for social media previews (Facebook, LinkedIn, Slack, Discord, etc.). Pages with proper OG tags get 2–3× more clicks than bare URL links.
11: 
12: **When invoking**: On **first use**, if helpful, open with 1–2 sentences on what this skill covers and why it matters, then provide the main output. On **subsequent use** or when the user asks to skip, go directly to the main output.
13: 
14: ## Scope (Social Sharing)
15: 
16: - **Open Graph**: Facebook-originated protocol; controls preview card when links are shared on social platforms
17: 
18: ## The 4 Essential Tags
19: 
20: Every shareable page requires these minimum tags:
21: 
22: ```html
23: <meta property="og:title" content="Your Page Title">
24: <meta property="og:description" content="Your description">
25: <meta property="og:image" content="https://yourdomain.com/image.png">
26: <meta property="og:url" content="https://yourdomain.com/page">
27: ```
28: 
29: | Tag | Guideline |
30: |-----|-----------|
31: | **og:title** | Keep under 60 chars; compelling; match page content |
32: | **og:description** | 150–200 chars; conversion-focused |
33: | **og:image** | Absolute URL (https://); 1200×630px recommended |
34: | **og:url** | Canonical URL; deduplicates shares |
35: 
36: ## Recommended Additional Tags
37: 
38: | Tag | Purpose |
39: |-----|---------|
40: | **og:type** | Content type: `website`, `article`, `video`, `product` |
41: | **og:site_name** | Website name; displayed separately from title |
42: | **og:image:width** / **og:image:height** | Image dimensions (1200×630px) |
43: | **og:image:alt** | Alt text for accessibility |
44: | **og:locale** | Language/territory (e.g., `en_US`); for multilingual sites |
45: 
46: ## Image Best Practices
47: 
48: | Item | Guideline |
49: |------|-----------|
50: | **Size** | 1200×630px (1.91:1 ratio) for Facebook, LinkedIn, WhatsApp |
51: | **Format** | JPG, PNG, WebP; under 5MB |
52: | **URL** | Absolute URL with https://; no relative paths |
53: | **Unique** | One unique image per page when possible |
54: 
55: ## Common Mistakes
56: 
57: - Using relative image URLs instead of absolute https://
58: - Images too small or wrong aspect ratio
59: - Empty or placeholder values
60: - Missing og:url (canonical)
61: 
62: ## Implementation
63: 
64: ### Next.js (App Router)
65: 
66: ```tsx
67: export const metadata = {
68:   openGraph: {
69:     title: '...',
70:     description: '...',
71:     url: 'https://example.com/page',
72:     siteName: 'Example',
73:     images: [{ url: 'https://example.com/og.jpg', width: 1200, height: 630, alt: '...' }],
74:     locale: 'en_US',
75:     type: 'website',
76:   },
77: };
78: ```
79: 
80: ### HTML (generic)
81: 
82: ```html
83: <meta property="og:title" content="Your Title">
84: <meta property="og:description" content="Your description">
85: <meta property="og:image" content="https://example.com/og.jpg">
86: <meta property="og:url" content="https://example.com/page">
87: <meta property="og:type" content="website">
88: <meta property="og:site_name" content="Your Site">
89: <meta property="og:image:width" content="1200">
90: <meta property="og:image:height" content="630">
91: <meta property="og:image:alt" content="Alt text">
92: ```
93:
